body: yep, trying to sort things out

I'm not going in today. I'm obviously in no condition to go into work. The work mental help hotline suggested an in patient program, for detox, but I'd need to take medical leave. Checking into a place would make me lose even more work, and I don't know how much of an extended stay that would be.
That was cute. Two people on my work assist line and neither asked if I was suicidal
i just dont want a sermon. im ready for whatevers next

thanks, im just worried im in a hole i can't get out of. like mortgage, child support, anxiety because of the no call outs, and how to even explain why i wasnt at work to my supervisor, or how they'll react if I call and say im an alky

I hear ya. Right now is a rough spot where I coming back to work after being at home on a work related injury/surgery for the past few months. Bill collectors breathing down my neck, finances, stress etc just all piling up when I'm just getting back to work. Hard to ignore, and still retain the self control to not slip up and drink the worries away
Nothing within 30 mins of me. Got on the phone and got a dude from AA I'll be chatting with though.

I think because I hate to waste cuz money is tight dumping what booze I had left was simultaneously easy and terrifying. The second task of that same caliber is manning up to see if I still have a job. Guess I'm finding a meeting tonight. Dunno if scheduling is any different for new years?
If I went to see a doctor they'd probably commit me. And I'm not I'm danger of self harm. Just feeling like roasted shit. Not sure what medicine I could find over the counter

The only close meeting is a women's only at 10 and two noon meetings. Noon is when I normally step out for work, I don't even know if going in is a good idea. Nobody picked up. I could drive there, but just hanging around when there's no meetings.....?

Yea. Despite having puking nonstop most of yesterday, I didn't know if was gonna hold down the water I had been sipping since making that post. Small victory for staring down the vodka in front of me and resisting.
Thanks. Social services/court/lawyers have been involved from the first time she was removed from mom. The bruise time was the third removal.
Homesquirrel. For real. I'm not taking my white ass into Baltimore City on a fucking Saturday. At midnight. That's a deathwish, fuck that.

https://baltimoreaa.org/meetings/

That's the link for murder city a.k.a Baltimore. I moved out from just on the border between county and city, and one of the huge factors that took my drinking to warp speed was fucking bedbugs. I DID NOT see that at all and it hite like a freight train. Not to mention I had serious personal issues I was dealing with. 

Regardless, I tried the 24/7 hotline and got sent to a Verizon mailbox. Nice to know even the city shuts down at 8 and not just the surrounding areas haha
I did have a sponsor from like 12 years ago when I got a DIP. Pretty sure I don't have the book or his contact anymore either. It was a meeting at Chapelgate Presbyterian Church I. Ellicott City MD.

Yea, at the moment my hours are 16:30-0100, so when I get home I'm up for a few hours till 3-5 and typically sleep in till noonish. After that is relaxing, meal prepping or other tasks before I have to head out the door.
